changes: Added facade schema-IR and number dependencies, benchmark DOM, dispatch and native schema-IR dependencies, std feature forwarding, and the std-gated jmax_bench binary target.

Unified the facade Document export with the native DOM/ABI representation. Parsing uses parse_with_numeric and into_validated, with no post-construction DOM traversal or facade floating-point string parser.

Moved CompiledSchema into the endpoint module and re-exported it at the crate root. It retains the original flat IR, authoritative native graph, ABI image, Arc<ValidatedProgram>, and a precomputed full-field selection.
Payload validation and extraction execute the retained program through CursorInput. Extraction uses the validated program field index and returns selected values in caller order.

Catalog construction compiles request and response projections once and builds an immutable open-addressed endpoint-code index at a maximum load factor of one half. validate_endpoint performs expected constant-time endpoint and schema lookup without schema recompilation.
Removed complete output revalidation from typed, document, and string encoding. Document encoding directly traverses validated native tables without rebuilding the input DOM.

Workload retains its CompiledSchema. The scalar workloads retain their original flat schemas; NumberArray, DepthBook and Nested now have exact native container graphs so all seven workload kinds support schema validation.

Extract invokes extract_payload with the cached program and workload selection. Full document and slot digests are computed before measurement; timed result consumption uses fixed-size summaries and black_box.

Serialization caches retained-document accounting during preparation and splits immutable documents from mutable sink state, removing the conflicting borrow and quadratic corpus-retention walk. Timed output consumption is constant-size; full round-trip verification remains untimed.

Added a deterministic CLI covering all 28 workload/mode pairs, explicit SIMD dispatch reporting, bounded configurable warmup and measurement counts, corpus dimensions and budgets, decimal or hexadecimal seeds, help, contextual errors, and broken-pipe handling. It retains summaries instead of all sample vectors between modes.

requirements.JM-04: facade integrated with shared CursorInput API
requirements.PERF-03: post-parse numeric walk removed; policy delegated to numeric-aware scanner
requirements.PERF-04: catalog programs cached; extraction uses indexed field lookup
requirements.PERF-05: redundant input reconstruction and output re-parsing removed
requirements.PERF-06: timing distortions removed and CLI added

api_notes: jsonmax::CompiledSchema remains available; jsonmax::endpoint::CompiledSchema is also public.

load_schema now accepts (SchemaImage, &SchemaIr, CompileLimits). The ABI image does not contain enough data to recreate a complete validated program. The function recompiles the supplied source once and verifies every image field before accepting it; request and benchmark paths never call it.
compile_native_schema supports rich graph schemas. For graph compilation, ir() exposes identity metadata and native_ir() preserves the authoritative graph.

NumberArray and Nested have array roots. The current schema slot model captures object properties and rejects capture below potentially repeated arrays. These two workloads therefore use empty strict selections; their Extract mode still invokes extract_payload and validates the complete native shape. The CLI states this explicitly.
The pre-existing unsupported stream-projection behavior remains explicit. Cached catalog entries cover request and response directions.
Timing percentiles and Payload Bytes describe complete corpus passes. Throughput uses decimal MB; Msg/sec counts individual documents. Zero-duration samples produce n/a rates rather than infinity.
Encoded document callers must preserve public ABI table and proof invariants. JsonEncode implementations must honor their valid-JSON contract.

observed_available: jmax_dom::Document aliases jmax_abi::node::ValidatedDocument and exposes parts(), payload(), metadata(), proof(), and into_validated().
jmax_schema_vm::input::CursorInput::new(Payload, Limits, NumericPolicy) returns a strict EventInput adapter.
